metadata.source: Official D DOCX/XLSX and DEM with explicit source mappings
metadata.node_elevation_rule: Retain official node-table elevation; DEM gives intervening terrain

fleet.turnaround.reason: No separate transport turnaround is supplied; next preparation/loading starts on return and already occupies the aircraft. Do not copy relay turnaround or synthetic 90 s.

fleet.hover_kw.status: official-rule interpretation, not measured hover power
fleet.hover_kw.reason: DOCX P0053-P0058 define trip transport energy as the sum of horizontal/cruise and additional climb energy, and supply no transport hover power; service affects time only under that rule.

gravity_m_s2.status: standard physical constant convention; not stated numerically in attachments

horizontal_and_climb_energy.status: physical completion of terms named by DOCX; explicit sub-formulas absent from P0053-P0055

relay_setup_waiting_energy.reason: Charge hover plus communication power during all post-arrival waiting and setup as well as active service; off-service communication timing is not explicitly separated by source.

ground_preparation_energy.status: no battery flight-energy charge during preparation
ground_preparation_energy.reason: No ground preparation power is provided; ground time occupies body and energy component, while flight/hover equations apply after launch.

metadata.energy_convention: Horizontal energy=usable_kwh*distance/range(load); climb=m*g*h/eta. Explicit model interpretation of DOCX energy terms, not additional official measurements.

pool.policy: Keep all baseline routes and feasible singleton routes; fill remaining slots by per-box aircraft occupation.

contract.grid_warning: Containing baseline routes does not contain its continuous start times. Off-grid starts and the finite cap can exclude that baseline; no incumbent does not prove the physical problem infeasible.
contract.comparison_scope: Transport-only energy and return makespan at one common baseline soft-tardiness ceiling. No relay energy optimization.
contract.code_origin: Exact quality-prescreen repair of outputs/review/pareto_fixed_quality.py; original/runtime modules unchanged.
contract.repair_proof: A binary selected column with individual nonnegative tardiness above the common ceiling cannot appear in any feasible solution, so deleting it preserves the feasible set.
